checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Steaming cup and consistent cream/dark green palette
must.why: All show a steaming cream cup on green/cream.

must.item: Exact brand, headline, CTA in each image
must.why: Wide version has a garbled button, and the headline has a glitch; vertical headline is clipped.

must.item: Same campaign look across all three
must.why: The cup, serif type and colour blocking match.

must.item: Layouts fit canvas without clipping or stretching
must.why: Vertical 'Daybreak' is cut off at both edges; square has a cream strip on the right edge; the wide version is crammed with artefacts.

exact_text.read_as: Square: correct. Vertical: 'Daybreak' clipped at the edges. Wide: 'Daybreak' with a glitched 'a' and 'k' plus green blob artefacts.
Square and vertical: Shop now. Wide: garbled glyphs, unreadable.

faults.what: Wide version's Shop now button text is garbled and unreadable.
Wide version's headline has glitch artefacts: green blobs on the D and a malformed 'k'.
Vertical headline 'Daybreak' is clipped at both left and right edges.
Square has a cream vertical strip at the right edge, and the cup sits close to the tagline.
Wide version has a cup partly cut at the lower right and a cream band at the right edge.

summary: The square version is good and the set shares one look, but the vertical headline is clipped and the wide version has a garbled button and a glitched headline, so it needs a redo.
